name: Atelier Prop
prompt:
Create ONE detailed source-compatible reusable GAME ROOM DECOR REFERENCE SHEET. Title INT-ATELIER-PROP-001 — PRINCESS ATELIER & HANDCRAFT DECOR. Exactly TWELVE clean isolated main prop cells in4x3 grid. One main three-quarter or broad-face illustration plus one small useful REAR, UNDERSIDE or OPEN/contact view of SAME object per cell. Short D01–D12 suffix and readable NAME beside each item; full sheet ID in header. Dimensions W,D,H in metres marked PROPOSED, objects may have independent illustration scales. Plain ivory studio background, even light, no humans, rooms, scenery, unlabeled extras or merged objects. Match supplied GEN-24 furniture vocabulary: ivory and rose-veined marble, slender muted gold rose/star/lotus detail, restrained indigo and blush accents. Preserve physical structure and show clear contacts, openings and true back thickness. No generic Gothic arch attached to tiny accessories. Complete tabletop/furniture objects stay human sized, small hardware remains tiny. Empty frames and glass displays must have real clear negative space. These are new source-compatible types, not recovered measured geometry.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D01 — Embroidery stand. Proposed W,D,H [0.6, 0.5, 1]m. One floor EMBROIDERY STAND, adjustable oval hoop with taut plain blush fabric, slender pole and three stable low feet. Clear hoop tilt joint; no seated person or chair.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D02 — Small floor loom. Proposed W,D,H [1.2, 0.75, 1.6]m. One small complete FLOOR LOOM, two parallel uprights and coherent top/bottom beams, straight warp threads passing through a visible heddle frame, small woven blush/indigo swatch. No human, room or impossible tangled yarn.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D03 — Canvas easel. Proposed W,D,H [0.7, 0.7, 1.75]m. One working H-FRAME CANVAS EASEL, two parallel front uprights, rear support and adjustable lower canvas ledge. One plain small blank canvas may show seating interface. Not an ornate gallery display picture frame. Front/side show same geometry.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D04 — Paint palette. Proposed W,D,H [0.3, 0.2, 0.025]m. One flat oval PAINT PALETTE with thumb hole and several tiny separate colour dabs, ivory wooden base and thin gold edge. Broad face up, no hand or easel attached.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D05 — Brush pot. Proposed W,D,H [0.12, 0.12, 0.25]m. One small cylindrical BRUSH POT, ivory/blush ceramic with gold star rim and hollow opening; four fine brush handles rise separately, no flowers or giant vase.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D06 — Thread spool set. Proposed W,D,H [0.3, 0.2, 0.2]m. Five separate small THREAD SPOOLS grouped on a low plain tray, visible circular flanges and coherent wound yarn in blush/ivory/indigo. No loom, furniture or floating threads.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D07 — Fabric roll. Proposed W,D,H [0.2, 1, 0.2]m. One horizontal FABRIC ROLL, open end spiral and short loose tail, ivory/blush cloth with indigo/gold floral border. Long axis1m; no bed, rug frame or architecture.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D08 — Pattern folio. Proposed W,D,H [0.35, 0.25, 0.05]m. One closed PATTERN FOLIO with slim ivory cover, blush binding ribbon and small gold star clasp. Tiny open-state inset shows plain folded pattern sheets, not a library book stack.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D09 — Scissor case. Proposed W,D,H [0.12, 0.25, 0.05]m. One flat SCISSOR CASE, blush leather with fine gold border and hinged/open flap exposing TWO distinct scissor handle loops. No giant knife, human hand or impossible fused scissors.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D10 — Needlework basket. Proposed W,D,H [0.4, 0.3, 0.25]m. One small NEEDLEWORK BASKET with open woven ivory body and blush lining, two yarn balls and folded cloth. Coherent weave, flat base, no hanging garland or whole chair.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D11 — Dress display torso stand. Proposed W,D,H [0.45, 0.4, 1.7]m. One human-sized fabric-covered DRESSMAKER TORSO on a narrow pole and stable three-foot base. Headless, armless mannequin, no human face, clothes, armor or display room. Clear wooden adjustment knob.

INT-ATELIER-PROP-001-D12 — Craft stool. Proposed W,D,H [0.45, 0.45, 0.5]m. One low CRAFT STOOL with round blush padded seat, ivory ring below, four slender gold/ivory legs and low bracing. No desk, wheels, flowers or chair back.
Footer: Proposed reference objects; anatomy-free props only; view parity, moving parts and mesh separation require model review.

visual_review_notes: Twelve requested craft props appear with separate back/underside or open-state views. Easel has working ledge and support, loom has visible warp/heddle elements, scissors sit in a distinct case and stool underside shows bracing.

Source ivory/rose, blush/indigo and gold motifs remain consistent. Fabric roll and five-spool set are coherent reference groupings; motion, weaving paths, scissor hinges and support stability remain unverified.
Dress form is a headless, armless non-character display prop. No living character or anatomy reference was generated.
